questions.text: Do you have a job, or are you studying?
questions.say: Good afternoon. My name is Daniel, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about what you do. Do you have a job, or are you studying?

questions.text: How did you feel on your first day?

cueCard.topic: Describe an online course or video that helped you learn something.
cueCard.explain: and explain why it was helpful for you.

questions.text: Describe an online course or video that helped you learn something.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe an online course or video that helped you learn something. You should say: what it was about; how you found it; what you learned from it; and explain why it was helpful for you.

questions.text: Would you pay for a course like this in the future?
questions.say: Thank you. Would you pay for a course like this in the future?

questions.text: What are the advantages of learning online?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about an online course or video that helped you learn something, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all online learning. What are the advantages of learning online?

questions.text: Why do some people give up online courses before they finish?
questions.say: Why do some people give up online courses before they finish?

questions.text: Can online courses ever replace teachers in a classroom?
questions.say: Can online courses ever replace teachers in a classroom?

questions.text: How has technology changed the way children learn at school?
questions.say: Now let's talk about education and technology. How has technology changed the way children learn at school?

questions.text: Should young children be allowed to use tablets in class?
questions.say: Should young children be allowed to use tablets in class?

questions.text: What skills will students need in a world with more and more technology?
